🔍Welcome to Find The Dogs 🔍

Venture through unique biomes like the Arctic🥶, Plains🌴, and the Island🏖️, to uncover 170 hidden dogs! Each one is waiting to be found—can you collect them all?

🎮 Play with Friends!
Team up or go solo to search for dogs, solve puzzles, and unlock hidden secrets across the map.
